title: Testing a Cloudflare Worker inside workerd.
description: How we moved Agent Idea's Worker tests from Node to workerd, with two Vitest projects and a real local KV binding.
lede: Our Worker was tested in Node, against a hand-made fake of its KV store. On 22 November we moved those tests into workerd, the runtime the Worker runs in.
summary: A practical guide to running Worker tests in workerd with @cloudflare/vitest-plugin, a real local KV binding, and a second Vitest project for the Node code.
